recipes.title: Native single select and form submission
recipes.use_when: Choose from a short fixed list without search or custom option content.
recipes.behavior_owner: Browser controls; host receives and validates GET parameters
recipes.keyboard: Native Tab, arrow keys, typeahead and form submission
recipes.fallback: Keep the labeled native select; enhance only if requirements exceed it.

recipes.title: Native action popover
recipes.use_when: Provide ordinary links or buttons in a lightweight nonmodal overlay.
recipes.behavior_owner: Browser Popover API, not ARIA menu-item arrow navigation
recipes.keyboard: Tab through actual buttons and links; Escape dismisses
recipes.fallback: Keep essential actions accessible through regular links or forms.

recipes.title: Native modal dialog with disclosure fallback
recipes.use_when: Require a short modal confirmation or preview on browsers supporting invoker commands.
recipes.behavior_owner: Browser dialog modal and focus behavior; application still owns side effects
recipes.keyboard: Enter opens on supporting browsers, Escape closes, native modal focus management
recipes.fallback: A real details disclosure in the example remains available if invoker commands fail.

recipes.title: Semantic table with truthful static sort state
recipes.use_when: Read data or display a server-sorted snapshot without interactive grid editing.
recipes.behavior_owner: Browser table semantics; server must implement and validate real sorting
recipes.keyboard: Tab into the named scroll region; regular links when server sorting is provided
recipes.fallback: Use actual GET sort links on a server endpoint; never fake interactive sorting with CSS.

recipes.title: Radix menu with real menu keyboard behavior
recipes.use_when: Need ARIA menu semantics, roving focus, arrow navigation and focus restoration.
recipes.behavior_owner: Radix DropdownMenu; host owns action authorization
test_markers: Radix action menu supports keyboard navigation and restores focus
recipes.keyboard: Arrow keys, Enter or Space, Escape and focus restoration
recipes.fallback: Use native popover with normal links and buttons when menu semantics are unnecessary.

recipes.title: React Aria searchable combobox
recipes.use_when: Need filtered selection, keyboard option navigation and accessible active focus.
recipes.behavior_owner: React Aria ComboBox; host owns async fetching and persistence
test_markers: React Aria combobox filters and selects options via keyboard
recipes.keyboard: Typed filtering, arrow navigation, Enter selection and IME support from library
recipes.fallback: Use a native select or GET search form if live suggestions are not necessary.

recipes.title: React Aria sortable inventory grid
recipes.use_when: Need real keyboard grid interactions and client-side sortable columns.
recipes.behavior_owner: React Aria Table for focus and ARIA; application sorts data
test_markers: React Aria sortable data grid changes DOM order
sortable data grid works from keyboard
recipes.keyboard: Column-header activation, grid navigation, announced sort state and retained focus
recipes.fallback: Use a plain table with server-side GET sorting unless grid keyboard behavior is needed.

recipes.title: Radix noncritical notification
recipes.use_when: Show transient noncritical feedback with a tested dismissal lifecycle.
recipes.behavior_owner: Radix Toast; host owns notification semantics and timing
test_markers: Radix toast can be announced, dismissed and remains nonblocking
recipes.keyboard: Focus, dismiss and nonblocking access provided by the toast primitive
recipes.fallback: Keep critical or irreversible messages inline or in a real dialog; do not auto-dismiss them.
